name: Kwon Ga Eul
source: Pure spirit and trusts people. Even if he's tormented by people, he often doesn't know if it's tormenting or not, so the 'tormentor' quits doing so. He doesn't know the world, and doesn't know what to do for himself so he's often used a lot.
